newsitem.title: sri lanka: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - January 28.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Tamil rebels execute 62 people accused of being "traitors" in northern areas under guerrilla control. Victims were accused of supplying information to the army, of criticising the LTTE and of having links with other Tamil militias and political parties.
New navy chief Rear Admiral Cecil Tissera says navy will be expanded to step up operations against Tamil Tiger rebels in waters surrounding island.
Residents of Beruwela tourist beach resort demonstrate to back demands for stern action against paedophiles accused of using children from orphans' home for sex and pornography.
Government dissolves local government bodies; polls to be held on March 27.
Police arrest top female Tamil rebel intelligence agent in Vavuniya refugee camp.
Italian authorities detain 78 Sri Lankan illegal immigrants who were on board Turkish ship which sank off coast of southern Italy on January 24.
